intro: Lewis' Note is an urgent supply requisition penned by Quartermaster Lewis at Sentinel Hill. Carried by courier via gryphon flight, it requests vital shipments of protective gear from a private armorer in Stormwind's Old Town.

p: The People's Militia at Sentinel Hill operates on a shoestring budget, receiving little official support from the House of Nobles in Stormwind. Facing persistent skirmishes against the Defias Brotherhood, the garrison regularly burns through its meager stocks of gear. To keep the defenders outfitted, Quartermaster Lewis relies on private business arrangements rather than crown logistics. This requisition note bypasses official military channels entirely, tasking an Alliance courier to fly by gryphon to Old Town and present the order directly to Osric Strang, proprietor of the shop Limited Immunity.
